description: Implementation of WiFi Access Point Associated Device API, including singleton management, device attribute getters, and internal data structures.

classes.name: hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_AssociatedDevice
classes.description: Represents an associated WiFi device with attributes like MAC address, signal strength, data rates, and state.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an instance of the associated device class for a given device ID.

methods.name: getAllInstances
methods.description: Returns a list of all current associated device instances.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Removes and deletes a specific associated device instance.

methods.name: closeAllInstances
methods.description: Removes and deletes all associated device instances.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_AssociatedDevice_MACAddress
methods.description: Gets the MAC address of the associated device.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_AssociatedDevice_AuthenticationState
methods.description: Gets the authentication state of the associated device.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_AssociatedDevice_LastDataDownlinkRate
methods.description: Gets the last data downlink rate for the device.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_AssociatedDevice_LastDataUplinkRate
methods.description: Gets the last data uplink rate for the device.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_AssociatedDevice_SignalStrength
methods.description: Gets the signal strength of the device.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_AssociatedDevice_Retransmissions
methods.description: Gets the number of retransmissions for the device.

methods.name: get_hostIf_WiFi_AccessPoint_AssociatedDevice_Active
methods.description: Checks if the device is active.
